name: Online-Dispatch Feedback Parity
triggering_diagnosis: E4.3 showed health and E1.7 states were updated in completion callbacks but never visible at dispatch in E4.2 because all Cloudlets were mapped before runtime feedback could propagate.
purpose: Validate runtime submission semantics in which completion feedback can causally affect later dispatch decisions without changing scientific parameters.
hard_gate: All parity_harness_requirements must PASS before any E4.2 campaign implementation is replaced or rerun.
